groups.description: Live hyperscaler and challenger cloud properties that this domain is modeled on — useful to see how compute, data, AI, and security services are positioned across global, regional, and sovereign providers.

links.title: Amazon Web Services
links.relevance: The largest reported public-cloud business and the breadth-of-services benchmark the Enterprise Cloud Transformation Leader and Cloud Application Builder evaluate portfolios against.

links.title: Microsoft Azure
links.relevance: An enterprise-first cloud with deep identity, hybrid, and Microsoft-ecosystem integration that shapes how Enterprise and Regulated Sector buyers weigh governance and incumbency.

links.title: Google Cloud
links.relevance: The data- and AI-led cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Kubernetes heritage) that sets expectations for the Cloud Application Builder's analytics and AI-platform jobs.

links.title: OVHcloud — European sovereign cloud
links.relevance: A European price-performance and sovereignty challenger; grounds the Regulated Sector Platform Owner's data-residency and sovereign-control buying criteria.

groups.description: Background on cloud spend management, FinOps practice, and the commercial discount models that shape adoption and retention economics.

links.title: Flexera — 2025 State of the Cloud report
links.relevance: Primary-source evidence that managing cloud spend is the top customer challenge — the market backdrop for the Cloud Platform and FinOps Operator's cost-control jobs.

links.title: FinOps Foundation — FOCUS billing-data specification
links.relevance: The open standard normalizing multicloud cost-and-usage data, central to how the FinOps Operator builds allocation, commitment, and chargeback reporting.

groups.description: How providers frame secure-by-default architecture and AI guardrails that regulated buyers must satisfy.

links.title: AWS Well-Architected Framework — the pillars
links.relevance: The reference for security, reliability, cost, and sustainability pillars that the Regulated Sector Platform Owner uses to prove audit-ready, resilient cloud design.

groups.description: Resources aimed at the builder and platform personas evaluating AI-application platforms and managed-service depth.

links.title: Amazon Bedrock — managed foundation-model platform
links.relevance: Example of the agent-and-model platform the Cloud Application Builder and Startup CTO build against when adding AI capabilities to production workloads.
